headline: Hold pattern continues: second legal idle while the walker keeps training
lede: Slot b's second straight kick re-derived the whole ladder against fresh main (3801994) and found the same answer: game queue empty, every honest gap on SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD and Myst carries a CLOSED marker, both QA nodes busy — STOP reported legal again per #841. The studio's only live build is slot a deep inside LEARNED WALK (#1205), its evolution-strategy trainer still running past the 75-minute mark.

notes.text: Ladder fully swept twice this window: halt/steer/next/game-queue all empty, #1205 claim refused (slot a's checkpoint 66 min old), QA-borrow forbidden (QA MASTER alive on studio and mini), flagship polish stage derived null from live READMEs. Nothing invented, nothing forced.
LEARNED WALK (#1205): slot a's session is 75 min into teaching the PHYSICS WALK rig to actually walk — (1+1)-ES generations in flight, checkpoints pushing to the branch.
Two open questions hit their defaults on 2026-11-03 unless Jon steers first: #1404 (what should the forge build next) and #1421 (how rule-4 streaks count across slots).
